preview: A missed package can affect more than the person waiting for it. In this episode, we look at the delivery process and what needs to be considered when trying to reduce missed deliveries.
comment_1: Listen for what the three people think about charging for another delivery.
comment_2: The key question is what should happen when no one is home to receive a package. Now, three people will share their own experiences.
comment_3: Why does the same issue look so different to each person? As you listen to the final thoughts, think about what each person can choose and what feels fair to them.
